verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable event-to-action rules engine, triggers, or event subscriptions for Vast.ai. Autobilling, which tops up the balance when it runs low, is a single fixed billing behavior. Serverless benchmark-driven scaling is platform-managed. Neither lets users define their own rules on events, so both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
